segments.sn16.12:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ca mahākassapo āyasmā ca sāriputto bārāṇasiyaṃ viharanti isipatane migadāye.
segments.sn16.12:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā sāriputto sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā mahākassapo tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahākassapena saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.sn16.12:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn16.12:1.4: “kiṃ nu kho, āvuso kassapa, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn16.12:1.7: “Kiṃ panāvuso, na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn16.12:1.10: “Kiṃ nu kho, āvuso, hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn16.12:1.12: ‘hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn16.12:1.13: “Kiṃ panāvuso, neva hoti, na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā”ti?
segments.sn16.12:1.15: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā’”ti.
segments.sn16.12:1.17: “Na hetaṃ, āvuso, atthasaṃhitaṃ nādibrahmacariyakaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn16.12:2.7: “Etañhi, āvuso, atthasaṃhitaṃ etaṃ ādibrahmacariyakaṃ etaṃ nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati.

lines: Na hetaṃ, āvuso, atthasaṃhitanti, āvuso, etaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ atthasannissitaṃ na hoti.
Etañhi, āvuso, atthasaṃhitanti, āvuso, etaṃ catusaccakammaṭṭhānaṃ atthasannissitaṃ.

Yathā atītakappe atītāsu jātīsu kammakilesavasena āgato, tathā etarahipi āgatoti tathāgato, yathā yathā vā pana kammaṃ katūpacitaṃ, tathā taṃ taṃ attabhāvaṃ āgato upagato upapannoti tathāgato, sattoti āha “tathāgatoti satto”ti.
Etanti “evaṃ hoti bhavati tiṭṭhati sassatisaman”ti evaṃ pavattaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ.
Atthasannissitaṃ na hotīti diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaparamatthato sukhanti pasatthasannissitaṃ na hoti.
Tassa pana etaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ ādipaṭipadāmattaṃ na hoti anupakārakattā vilomanato ca.
